title: Anatomy sync
description: Keeps the Pack anatomy island in step with the code. Its reader (reader.ts) reads each file's imports, pack and header comment the way the structure test checks the architecture; its extractors (extract.ts), one per kind of source, turn the manifests, the modules, the tests and the structure checks into the island's keyed items and links; and its plan (plan.ts) is what a run sends, from what changed since the island's last sync. GitHub's push webhook runs it (push.ts) with a read-only token the owner gives it, and a catch-up (catch-up.ts) as the server starts and every hour brings the island to main when a push was missed; scripts/anatomy.ts runs it from git, and --full is the whole check.
